A client call is about to start and you need to know why the homepage rebuild is stuck. You ask an AI, and a clear, confident answer comes back. Can you repeat it on the call?

## Why it is hard

A confident answer can still be wrong. It may rest on an old note, mix up two projects or fill a gap with a guess. If the answer comes without sources, your choices are to trust it blindly or to search everything yourself, which is the work you hoped to skip.

## How Genos helps

Genos AI answers from your workspace and shows what it drew on as links: the threads, notes, tasks and projects. Click one to open it and read the original.

```flow
Ask in plain words
Read the answer
Open the source
Repeat it with confidence
```

It reads only what you can already open. It cannot see a teammate's private notes or a chat you are not in.

You can also ask where the material is. A thread and a note each have an **Ask** button (the sparkle icon) in their header, and a task has **Ask Genos about this task** in its menu, so the answer stays about that one thing.

## What you get

- **A quick check before you pass it on.** Open the task it names and see that it really is blocked.
- **Less searching.** You go straight to the few places that matter instead of scrolling a week of chat.
- **Better follow-up questions.** Reading the source often shows you the next thing to ask.
- **An answer you can keep.** Save it as a note or as a task, so the next person does not have to ask again.

An AI can still get things wrong, links or not. The links are what let you find out in time.

## How to start

1. Press Cmd-K (Ctrl-K on Windows and Linux) anywhere.
2. Type a real question, for example "What is blocking the homepage rebuild?" Use `#` to name a project or task.
3. Open at least one source before you act on the answer.

Asking uses your plan's AI allowance, and Free includes some. Typing in the same box just searches, without an AI answer.
